title: Model picker tool dispatch
responsibility: Validates picker tool arguments and routes catalog, status, switch and cancellation operations to the provider-switch service.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.service
inputs.description: The provider-switch service the dispatcher calls: catalog.list() for list_models, store.list() for list_observed_sessions, request() for request_model_switch, cancel() for cancel_model_switch, and status() for open_model_picker and get_provider_status. The dispatcher performs no check on it before calling these members.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.name
inputs.description: The operation to run: list_models, list_observed_sessions, request_model_switch, cancel_model_switch, open_model_picker or get_provider_status; open_model_picker and get_provider_status both call service.status. Any other string rejects with an Error before any service member is called.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.input
inputs.description: Arguments for the operation, parsed by the strict schema for that operation: pickerSwitchSchema for request_model_switch, pickerCancelSchema for cancel_model_switch, and pickerSessionSchema for open_model_picker and get_provider_status. list_models and list_observed_sessions never read it, and a value that fails its schema rejects with a ZodError.

outputs.name: pickerSessionSchema
outputs.description: Strict zod object schema for open_model_picker and get_provider_status arguments: it accepts an optional string session_id and rejects any other key. The dispatcher parses input with it and passes session_id, or null when it is absent, to service.status.

outputs.name: pickerSwitchSchema
outputs.description: Strict zod object schema for request_model_switch arguments: session_id, model and effort must be strings, provider must be 'openai' or 'harness-claude', and any other key is rejected. The dispatcher passes session_id as the first argument to service.request and provider, model and effort in an object as the second argument.

outputs.name: pickerCancelSchema
outputs.description: Strict zod object schema for cancel_model_switch arguments: session_id and request_id must both be strings, and any other key is rejected. The dispatcher passes session_id and request_id, in that order, to service.cancel.

outputs.name: pickerMcpTools
outputs.description: Resolves to { models: <catalog.list() result> } for list_models, to { sessions: <store.list() result> } for list_observed_sessions, and otherwise to the result of service.request, service.cancel or service.status. For open_model_picker and get_provider_status a missing session_id reaches service.status as null, and the dispatcher does not launch a UI itself.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Unknown picker operation.' when name is none of the six operations; because pickerMcpTools is async, the caller receives it as a rejected promise.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by the zod parse call when input fails the schema for its operation, for example a missing required string, a provider other than 'openai' or 'harness-claude', or an extra key; the returned promise rejects with it.

errors.name: service error
errors.description: Not caught in this file: any error thrown or promise rejected by service.catalog.list, service.store.list, service.request, service.cancel or service.status propagates unchanged, so its name is defined by the provider-switch service.
